f.title: Establish standard operating procedures for the clinical study
f.statement: The sponsor must establish standard operating procedures (written working procedures).

rows.quote: Las obligaciones del promotor son las siguientes: a) Establecer procedimientos operativos estándar (Procedimientos normatizados de trabajo).
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The obligations of the sponsor are the following: a) To establish standard operating procedures (standardised working procedures).

f.title: Provide and update the available product information throughout the study
f.statement: The sponsor must provide all available basic and clinical information on the investigational product and update it throughout the study.

rows.quote: Proporcionar toda la información básica y clínica disponible del producto en investigación y actualizar la misma a lo largo del estudio.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: To provide all the available basic and clinical information on the investigational product and update it throughout the study.

f.title: Report serious unexpected adverse reactions to DMTS and the ethics committee
f.statement: The sponsor must communicate to the DMTS and to the clinical research ethics committees involved in the study all serious and unexpected adverse reactions that may be related to the investigational treatments, whether they occurred in Bolivia or abroad.
f.applicability: Serious and unexpected adverse reactions possibly related to the investigational treatment, domestic and foreign

rows.quote: Comunicar a la Dirección de Medicamentos y Tecnología en Salud y al Comité Ético de Investigación Clínica involucrados en el estudio: 1. Todas las reacciones adversas graves e inesperadas que puedan estar relacionados con los tratamientos en investigación, ocurridos dentro o fuera del país.
rows.review_note: Review: no time limit stated here (Art. 57 refers to time limits to be set). Re-translation agrees. Double-check: statement within the quote.
rows.quote_en: To communicate to the Directorate of Medicines and Health Technology and to the Clinical Research Ethics Committee involved in the study: 1. All serious and unexpected adverse reactions that may be related to the investigational treatments, occurring inside or outside the country.

f.title: Report animal findings suggesting significant human risk and protect subjects
f.statement: The sponsor must communicate to the DMTS and the ethics committee any information from animal studies suggesting a significant risk for humans, including any finding of teratogenicity or carcinogenicity; the sponsor and the investigator must take the measures needed to protect study subjects.

rows.quote: Cualquier información derivada de estudios realizados en animales, que sugiera un riesgo significativo para los seres humanos, incluyendo cualquier hallazgo de teratogenicidad o carcinogenicidad. El promotor junto con el investigador tomarán las medidas necesarias para la protección de los sujetos del estudio.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Any information derived from studies in animals that suggests a significant risk for human beings, including any finding of teratogenicity or carcinogenicity. The sponsor together with the investigator shall take the necessary measures for the protection of the study subjects.

f.title: Give investigators and ethics committees information of immediate importance
f.statement: The sponsor must provide the investigator and, where appropriate, the ethics committee with any information of immediate importance to which it has access during the study.

rows.quote: Proporcionar al investigador y al Comité Ético de Investigación Clínica cuando proceda, cualquier información de importancia inmediata a la que tenga acceso durante el estudio.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: To provide the investigator and the Clinical Research Ethics Committee, where appropriate, with any information of immediate importance to which it has access during the study.

f.title: Prepare final or interim study reports and send them to DMTS
f.statement: The sponsor must agree with the investigator on data processing, reporting and publication; in any case the sponsor is responsible for preparing the final or interim study reports and communicating them to the DMTS, with the investigator's knowledge and acceptance.

rows.quote: En cualquier caso, el promotor es responsable de elaborar los informes finales o parciales del estudio y comunicarlos a la Dirección de Medicamentos y Tecnología en Salud del Ministerio de Salud y Deportes, con conocimiento y aceptación del investigador.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: In any case, the sponsor is responsible for preparing the final or interim reports of the study and communicating them to the Directorate of Medicines and Health Technology of the Ministry of Health and Sports, with the knowledge and acceptance of the investigator.

f.title: Act on serious or unexpected adverse reactions and inform all parties immediately
f.statement: The investigator must take appropriate measures in case of serious or unexpected adverse reactions and immediately inform the DMTS, the ethics committee, the sponsor and the monitor, as well as the authorities of the health establishment where the study is conducted.

rows.quote: Tomar las medidas adecuadas en caso de reacciones adversas graves o inesperadas y poner inmediatamente en conocimiento de las mismas a la Dirección de Medicamentos y Tecnología en Salud, al Comité Ético de Investigación Clínica, al promotor y al monitor, así como las autoridades del establecimiento de salud en el cual se lleva a cabo el estudio.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: To take appropriate measures in the event of serious or unexpected adverse reactions and immediately inform the Directorate of Medicines and Health Technology, the Clinical Research Ethics Committee, the sponsor and the monitor, as well as the authorities of the health establishment where the study is conducted.

f.title: Submit the final study communication within 180 days of study end
f.statement: The investigator must submit a final communication to the DMTS, the ethics committee and the sponsor no later than 180 days after the end of the study.

rows.deadline: Within 180 days after the end of the study
rows.quote: Presentar una comunicación final (en un plazo no mayor a 180 días posteriores a la finalización del estudio) a la Dirección de Medicamentos y Tecnología en Salud, al Comité Ético de Investigación Clínica y al promotor.
rows.review_note: Review: días read as calendar days (not qualified). Re-translation agrees. Double-check: unit inferred, 88.
rows.quote_en: To submit a final communication (within a period of no more than 180 days after the end of the study) to the Directorate of Medicines and Health Technology, the Clinical Research Ethics Committee and the sponsor.

deadline_rule.applies_to: final study communication by the investigator

f.title: Submit six-monthly progress reports for studies over 12 months
f.statement: For studies lasting more than 12 months, the investigator must submit a report every six months (to the DMTS, the ethics committee and the sponsor).

rows.quote: En los estudios cuya duración sea mayor a 12 meses, se deberá presentar un informe cada seis meses.
rows.review_note: Review: recipients taken from the preceding sentence of 48(i). Re-translation agrees. Double-check: periodic interval, no deadline_rule; recipients inferred.
rows.quote_en: In studies lasting more than 12 months, a report shall be submitted every six months.

f.title: Archive study information for at least two years
f.statement: The investigator must archive the information recorded before, during and after the study for a minimum of two years.

rows.quote: Archivar la información registrada antes, durante y después del estudio durante un plazo mínimo de dos años.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: To archive the information recorded before, during and after the study for a minimum period of two years.

f.title: Notify the sponsor immediately of all adverse reactions
f.statement: The investigator is obliged to notify the study sponsor immediately of all adverse reactions.

rows.quote: El investigador está obligado a notificar de forma inmediata al promotor del estudio todas las reacciones adversas.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The investigator is obliged to notify the study sponsor immediately of all adverse reactions.

f.title: Notify DMTS and ethics committees of related events on the Annex 8 form
f.statement: The sponsor must notify the DMTS and the ethics committees involved in the study of all events that may be related to the investigational treatments, whether they occurred in Bolivia or in other countries, on the notification form in Annex 8, within the time limits to be established.

rows.deadline: Within the time limits to be established (not set in this norm)
rows.quote: El promotor notificará a la Dirección de Medicamentos y Tecnología en Salud del Ministerio de Salud y Deportes y al Comité Ético de Investigación Clínica involucrados en el estudio todos los acontecimientos que puedan estar relacionados con los tratamientos en investigación que hayan ocurrido tanto en Bolivia como en otros países, en el formulario de notificación recogido en el anexo 8 en los plazos que se establezcan.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor shall notify the Directorate of Medicines and Health Technology of the Ministry of Health and Sports and the Clinical Research Ethics Committee involved in the study of all events that may be related to the investigational treatments that have occurred both in Bolivia and in other countries, on the notification form in Annex 8, within the time limits that are established.

f.title: Keep batch manufacturing records and retain samples 12 months past expiry
f.statement: The sponsor must keep, in the main study file, the manufacturing and control protocols of the batches made for the clinical study; samples of each batch must be kept until twelve months after the expiry date.
f.clause: Chapter 14 Muestras para investigación clínica, Art. 56

rows.deadline: Samples: until 12 months after expiry date
rows.quote: El promotor conservará en el archivo principal del estudio los protocolos de fabricación y control de los lotes de productos fabricados para el estudio clínico. Asimismo las muestras de cada lote se conservarán hasta doce meses después de la fecha de caducidad.
rows.location: Chapter 14 Muestras para investigación clínica, Art. 56
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor shall keep in the main study file the manufacturing and control protocols of the batches of products manufactured for the clinical study. Likewise, samples of each batch shall be kept until twelve months after the expiry date.

f.title: Take responsibility for archiving the study documentation
f.statement: The study sponsor is responsible for archiving the study documentation.
f.clause: Chapter 17 Archivo de la documentación del estudio, Art. 61

rows.quote: El promotor del estudio es responsable del archivo de la documentación del estudio.
rows.location: Chapter 17 Archivo de la documentación del estudio, Art. 61
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The study sponsor is responsible for archiving the study documentation.

f.title: Keep subject identification codes for at least 15 years
f.statement: The investigator must ensure that the subject identification codes are kept for at least fifteen years after the study is completed or discontinued.

rows.deadline: At least 15 years after completion or interruption of the study
rows.quote: El investigador se ocupará de que los códigos de identificación de los sujetos se conserven durante al menos quince años después de concluido o interrumpido el estudio.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The investigator shall ensure that the subject identification codes are kept for at least fifteen years after the study has been completed or interrupted.

f.title: Retain the study documentation for the validity period of the medicine
f.statement: The sponsor or data owner must keep all other study documentation for the period of validity of the medicine, including: the protocol (rationale, objectives, statistical design, methodology, conditions and investigational product details), the standard operating procedures, all written reports on the protocol and procedures, the investigator's brochure, the case report form of each subject, the final report and the audit certificate where applicable.

rows.deadline: For the period of validity of the medicine
rows.quote: El promotor o el propietario de los datos conservarán toda la restante documentación relativa al estudio durante el período de validez del medicamento.
rows.review_note: Review: list of documents (Art. 64 a-g) summarised in the statement from the same article. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: list items not in the quote, 88.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor or the owner of the data shall keep all the remaining documentation relating to the study during the period of validity of the medicine.

f.title: Keep the final study report until 5 years after the medicine's validity ends
f.statement: The sponsor or subsequent owner must keep the final report until five years after the period of validity of the medicine has expired.

rows.deadline: Until 5 years after the medicine's validity period expires
rows.quote: El promotor o el propietario subsiguiente conservarán el informe final hasta cinco años después de haberse agotado el plazo de validez del medicamento.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: The sponsor or the subsequent owner shall keep the final report until five years after the period of validity of the medicine has expired.

f.title: Document every change in ownership of study data
f.statement: Every change in the ownership of the study data must be documented.

rows.quote: Se documentará todo cambio que se produzca en la posesión de los datos.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: Any change that occurs in the possession of the data shall be documented.

f.title: Make study data and documents available to authorities on request and keep them confidential
f.statement: All study data and documents must be made available to the competent authorities if they so request, and the confidentiality of the data and documents in the archive must be ensured in all cases.
f.processes: Data integrity & records; Audit & inspection readiness

rows.quote: Todos los datos y documentos se pondrán a disposición de las autoridades competentes si éstas así lo solicitan. Artículo 68. Se asegurará, en todo caso, la confidencialidad de los datos y documentos contenidos en el archivo.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: All data and documents shall be made available to the competent authorities if they so request. Article 68. The confidentiality of the data and documents contained in the archive shall be ensured in all cases.

f.title: Report compassionate-use outcomes and adverse reactions to DMTS
f.statement: For compassionate use of investigational or off-label products, the physician in charge must communicate to the DMTS the results of the treatment and the adverse reactions that may be due to it.
f.applicability: Compassionate use of investigational products or of authorised products outside authorised conditions

rows.quote: El médico encargado comunicará a la Dirección de Medicamentos y Tecnología en Salud los resultados del tratamiento, así como las reacciones adversas que puedan ser debidas al mismo.
rows.review_note: Review: duty falls on the treating physician, not the company; kept because companies supplying compassionate use need to support it. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: non-company actor, 86.
rows.quote_en: The physician in charge shall communicate to the Directorate of Medicines and Health Technology the results of the treatment, as well as the adverse reactions that may be due to it.

f.title: Send the final study report to DMTS and notify study end to the ethics committee
f.statement: Once the study is finished the sponsor must send the DMTS the final report on its results, signed with the investigator to vouch for the accuracy of the data and their agreement with the source data; it must also notify the end of the study to the ethics committee and, where the study is conducted in the interior of the country, to the Departmental Health Services.
f.clause: Chapter 27 Informe final del estudio clínico, Art. 97

rows.quote: Una vez terminada la realización del estudio el promotor enviará a la Dirección de Medicamentos y Tecnología en Salud el informe final sobre los resultados del mismo, responsabilizándose con su firma junto con la del investigador de la veracidad de los datos reflejados en la comunicación y de su concordancia con los datos originales obtenidos.
rows.location: Chapter 27 Informe final del estudio clínico, Art. 97
rows.review_note: Review: end-of-study notification to EC taken from the last sentence of Art. 97. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: statement slightly beyond the quote, 88.
rows.quote_en: Once the study has been completed, the sponsor shall send to the Directorate of Medicines and Health Technology the final report on its results, taking responsibility, by its signature together with that of the investigator, for the accuracy of the data reflected in the communication and their agreement with the original data obtained.

f.title: Submit an annual progress report for studies longer than one year
f.statement: When the study lasts more than one year, the sponsor must also send the DMTS an annual report on its progress.
f.applicability: Studies lasting more than one year

rows.quote: Cuando la duración del estudio sea superior a un año, será necesario además que el promotor remita un informe anual sobre la marcha del mismo.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: When the duration of the study exceeds one year, it shall also be necessary for the sponsor to send an annual report on its progress.

f.title: Report data and reasons when a study is stopped early
f.statement: If the research is not completed, the sponsor must send the DMTS a report including the data obtained up to the suspension and the reasons for it.

rows.quote: En el caso de que la investigación no llegue a su fin, el promotor enviará a la Dirección de Medicamentos y Tecnología en Salud un informe que incluya los datos obtenidos hasta su suspensión y los motivos de ésta.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: If the research does not reach its end, the sponsor shall send to the Directorate of Medicines and Health Technology a report including the data obtained up to its suspension and the reasons for it.

f.title: Make SOPs mandatory for all study participants before the study starts
f.statement: Good Clinical Practice requires standard operating procedures detailing the conduct for organising, performing, collecting data, documenting and verifying clinical studies. The sponsor is responsible for establishing them and for ensuring that knowing and applying them is mandatory for everyone taking part in a clinical study, especially the study monitor, before the study starts.

rows.quote: Es responsabilidad del promotor establecerlos y garantizar que su conocimiento y puesta en práctica sean de carácter obligatorio para todos aquellos que participan en un estudio clínico, especialmente para el monitor del estudio, antes de iniciar éste.
rows.review_note: Review: quote, statement and level checked against the original text; no change. Re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force. Double-check: statement stays within the quote.
rows.quote_en: It is the responsibility of the sponsor to establish them and to ensure that knowledge and implementation of them are mandatory for all those who take part in a clinical study, especially for the study monitor, before it starts.

f.title: Cover adverse reaction notification and archiving in the SOPs
f.statement: The SOPs must at least regulate: the archiving of essential study documentation, including adverse reaction notifications and monitoring reports, with archiving periods defined both at the investigator site and at the sponsor; and the procedure for notifying adverse reactions in line with national rules.

rows.quote: Procedimiento de archivo de la documentación esencial del estudio clínico: protocolo y enmiendas, cuadernos de recolección de datos e informes complementarios, notificación de reacciones adversas e informes de monitorización. Se definirán los tiempos de archivo, tanto en el centro asistencial del investigador como en el del promotor.
rows.review_note: Review: item (e) "Procedimiento de notificación de reacciones adversas de acuerdo a normas nacionales" added to the statement from the same list. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: Procedure for archiving the essential documentation of the clinical study: protocol and amendments, case report forms and supplementary reports, notification of adverse reactions and monitoring reports. Archiving periods shall be defined both at the investigator's healthcare centre and at the sponsor's.

f.title: Define adverse reaction data, causality criteria and expedited notification in the protocol
f.statement: The study protocol must, in its adverse reactions section: state the minimum information to record for adverse reactions (description, seriousness, duration, time sequence, detection method, treatment given and, where applicable, alternative causes or predisposing factors); state the causality criteria to be used; state the procedures for immediate notification of serious or unexpected adverse reactions; and include a model adverse reaction notification sheet for the health authorities (Annex 8).
f.clause: Annex 1 Estructuración y contenido de un protocolo, IX. Reacciones adversas

rows.quote: a) Indicar la información mínima que se deberá especificar para los reacciones adversas que ocurran a un sujeto durante el estudio (descripción, gravedad, duración, secuencia temporal, método de detección, tratamiento administrado, en su caso, causas alternativas o factores predisponentes). b) Indicar criterios de imputabilidad que se van a utilizar.
rows.location: Annex 1 Estructuración y contenido de un protocolo, IX. Reacciones adversas
rows.review_note: Review: items c) and d) (immediate notification procedures; Annex 8 model sheet) are on the next page and summarised in the statement. Level: annex structure requirement read as Mandatory. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: 86.
rows.quote_en: a) State the minimum information to be specified for adverse reactions occurring to a subject during the study (description, seriousness, duration, time sequence, detection method, treatment administered and, where applicable, alternative causes or predisposing factors). b) State the causality criteria to be used.
